verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an integrations catalog under /integrations/overview, with dedicated setup guides for Jira and ClickUp (ticketing), JumpCloud (identity), and FreeAgent (used to map users and check offboarding). The quickstart also says Sprinto integrates with your existing cloud stack for continuous monitoring. However, the evidence only covers some of the stack categories the story names, and nothing addresses permission scopes. Missing for 10: specific cloud-provider integrations (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure), code-hosting integrations, explicit MDM integrations, documentation of read-only scopes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
